name: Batz
summary:
Batz is a small, currently non-profit VR game that features high-speed, Gorilla Tag-style movement—but with bats instead of monkeys! Jump, climb, and bounce around the map using nothing but your hands

Batz features multiple custom game modes to switch up the action, including speed wall, horror, king of the hill, only up, and so many others! You can also visit the shop to customize your bat and style your character before exploring and chasing your friends across a variety of unique, vertically driven maps
